name: spr
title: SPR (subtree prune and regraft)
description: The rooted subtree-prune-and-regraft (SPR) distance: the fewest moves, each cutting off a subtree and reattaching it elsewhere, that turn one tree into the other. It equals the size of a maximum agreement forest minus one, so the forest is also shown: the blocks of leaves both trees arrange identically, every block but the root's being one move. The exact distance is NP-hard to compute and is reported only when it is small enough to search, within 10 seconds; otherwise a range, from a linear-time 3-approximation. Computed by rspr, run as a separate program.

reference.citation: rspr 1.3.1 by C. Whidden, run as a separate program: exact rooted SPR distances and maximum agreement forests (Whidden, Beiko & Zeh), with a linear-time 3-approximation.

presentations.name: branches
presentations.label: How intact each clade is
presentations.description: Branches: blue where the clade moved as one piece, yellow where it broke apart, grey on a leaf

presentations.name: leaves
presentations.label: Largest block, moved together or moved alone
presentations.description: Leaves: blue in the largest group both trees share, teal if moved with others, yellow if moved alone, red if only in one tree

summary.label: SPR distance
summary.description: The rooted SPR distance is at least this: the exact value when the search finished, else a third of the approximation, rounded up.

summary.label: SPR distance, at most
summary.description: The rooted SPR distance is at most this: the exact value when the search finished, else the smallest agreement forest found, less one.

summary.label: Exact
summary.description: Whether the exact search finished, so that the two bounds are equal.

summary.label: Blocks in the agreement forest
summary.description: The root's block and every moved one.

columns.name: moved
columns.label: Leaves of this clade outside the largest block
columns.description: How many of the clade's leaves are in a block other than the agreement forest's largest: 1 or 0 at a leaf. Empty (NaN) outside the compared pair.

columns.name: grouped
columns.label: Leaves of this clade moved with others
columns.description: How many of the clade's leaves are in a moved block of two or more leaves: 1 or 0 at a leaf. Empty (NaN) outside the compared pair.

columns.name: alone
columns.label: Leaves of this clade moved alone
columns.description: How many of the clade's leaves are moved blocks of one leaf: 1 or 0 at a leaf. With the column before, they add up to the moved leaves. Empty (NaN) outside the compared pair.

columns.name: similarity
columns.label: How intact the clade is
columns.description: 1 - (pieces - 1) / (leaves - 1), where pieces is how many forest blocks the clade's leaves fall into; a leaf is 1.

columns.name: corresponds
columns.label: The smallest clade of the other tree holding this clade's leaves
columns.description: A leaf is linked to itself.
